Subject: 20% off our toughest pack — ends Sunday
Preview: The Cascade 45L is built for the trail. Grab 20% off before Sunday.
Body: Your next trip deserves a pack that keeps up.

The Northbay Cascade 45L is our toughest pack — 45 liters of capacity, an internal frame, and a water-resistant ripstop nylon shell, all at 1.4 kg. It carries what you need without slowing you down.

45L fits a multi-day load. The internal frame keeps weight close to your back on uneven terrain. The ripstop nylon shell handles light rain and trail abuse — note that it's water-resistant, not waterproof, so a pack cover makes sense in heavy downpour.

Now through Sunday, take 20% off the Cascade 45L.
